description: A script for seeding a PostgreSQL database with roles, competencies, role adjacency, mappings, users, plans, and goals, either from JSON files or a minimal fallback dataset. It also verifies backend endpoints after seeding.

methods.name: _load_json_list
methods.description: Loads a JSON array from a specified file in the data directory, with fallback and error handling.

methods.name: _ensure_catalog_tables
methods.description: Creates necessary catalog tables in the database if they do not exist.

methods.name: _upsert_roles
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert or update of role records based on provided data.

methods.name: _upsert_competencies
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert or update of competency records.

methods.name: _translate_adjacency_codes_to_ids
methods.description: Converts adjacency data using role codes into role IDs using existing role data.

methods.name: _translate_mappings_codes_to_ids
methods.description: Converts role-competency mapping data from codes to IDs.

methods.name: _upsert_role_competencies
methods.description: Inserts or updates role-competency requirement records.

methods.name: _upsert_role_adjacency
methods.description: Inserts or updates role adjacency records.

methods.name: _upsert_simple_users
methods.description: Creates or updates simple user records in demo_users table.

methods.name: _upsert_plans
methods.description: Inserts or updates career plan records, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _upsert_goals
methods.description: Inserts or updates goal records, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _fallback_dataset
methods.description: Provides a minimal hardcoded dataset for roles, competencies, adjacency, mappings, users, plans, and goals.

methods.name: _ensure_users_for_plans
methods.description: Ensures user records exist for each plan's user_id, creating placeholders if necessary.

methods.name: _attach_goals_by_title
methods.description: Links goals to plans by resolving plan IDs from plan titles.

methods.name: seed_full
methods.description: Main function to seed the database with data from JSON or fallback, verify endpoints, and return a summary.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to execute the seed_full process and print results.
